products.title: UAHPET Elevated Cat Bowls
products.body_html:
Comfortable, practical feeding for cats

The UAHPET Elevated Cat Bowls set raises food to a 5.6-inch feeding height and positions the bowls at a 17° angle. The elevated, tilted design may provide a more comfortable eating position for some cats, but the best setup depends on your cat’s size, mobility, preferences, and veterinary needs.

Two removable bowls

Use the two bowls for wet and dry food, two separate portions, or two compatible cats. In multi-cat homes, watch for guarding, rushing, or one cat eating the other’s portion. Cats that compete at meals may still need feeding stations in separate locations.

Wide, shallow bowl shape

Each bowl is 6.5 inches wide with a shallow profile, giving whiskers more clearance around the rim. Individual cats have different bowl preferences, so introduce the new setup gradually and observe whether your cat eats comfortably.

17° tilted design

The angled bowl helps keep food gathered toward the center for easier access and less scattering around the feeding area.

Food-grade melamine construction

The bowls are made from 5A food-grade melamine with a smooth, durable surface. They are dishwasher-friendly for routine cleaning but are not microwave-safe. Inspect regularly and replace any bowl that becomes cracked, chipped, or deeply scratched.

Stable, quieter base

A non-slip pad helps limit sliding and reduces bowl movement and floor contact noise during meals. Place the set on a clean, level surface.

Care instructions

  • Wash before first use and after wet-food meals.
  • Remove leftover food promptly.
  • Use the dishwasher or wash with warm water and dish soap, then rinse and dry.
  • Do not microwave.
  • Check the bowls and anti-slip base regularly for wear.

Elevated bowls are feeding equipment, not a treatment for vomiting, digestive disease, spinal problems, or other medical conditions. If your cat has difficulty eating, repeated vomiting, pain, or an appetite change, contact your veterinarian.

Need help planning meals for more than one pet? Read our two-bowl and multi-pet feeding guide.
